requirements_summary:
Workload: primary product is customer-facing chat + policy reranking for claims triage.
Targets: p95 latency target 200ms for short-turn chat (<=512 tokens), p99 <500ms; throughput target 250 requests/sec steady-state with spikes to 800 rps during batch claims events.
Cost sensitivity: unit economics critical for multi-product rollout; CFO wants clear $/1k-token and $/req per traffic profile.
Model prefs: open weights preferred (LLama/Redwood-verified); occasional fallback to smaller quantized variants for cost spikes.
Routing/fallback: geo-aware routing (NA primary, EU DR), automatic fallback to smaller model or queued burst capacity.
Security: VPC-only control plane, customer KMS for keys, 7-year audit log retention for regulated data subsets.
cost_model_summary:
Summary of scenarios run for reserved capacity (POC delivered 2026-03-04):

Scenario A - Conservative reserve (baseline)
- Reserved: 4x A100-class GPUs (rush estimate)
- Commit: $90k/month (reserved pool + support premium)
- Assumptions: effective utilization 65% (scheduling, cold cache, KV misses), average request size 400 tokens (including replies), batching average 6 requests per batch during steady-state.
- Unit economics: modeled token cost ~ $0.00038 per token (includes infra amortization + ops + SW license allocation).
- Comments: meets p95=180-210ms in NA with continuous batching; expensive for rare spikes.

Scenario B - Aggressive commit (preferred by Pelagia to reduce unit cost)
- Reserved: 8x A100-class GPUs + burst pool (on-demand)
- Commit: $160k/month (volume discount applied)
- Assumptions: effective utilization 78% (more aggressive scheduling + caching), batching average 8, KV cache hit 55%.
- Unit economics: token cost ~ $0.00021 per token.
- Tradeoffs: lower marginal cost but higher committed spend; requires >70% utilization to realize savings.

Scenario C - Hybrid (VPC + on-prem burst)
- Reserved: 6x GPUs in Redwood Dedicated (VPC) + 2x on-prem nodes for ultra-low-latency paths
- Commit: $120k/month + on-prem amortized $15k/mo (ops)
- Assumptions: utilization 70% across the hybrid pool, small fraction (10%) of requests routed to on-prem for <120ms p95 SLA.
- Unit economics: blended token cost ~ $0.00026/token.

Key sensitivity levers used in model:
- Utilization delta +/-10% changes token cost by ~20-30%.
- KV cache hit from 30% -> 60% reduces per-token inference compute by ~25%.
- Batching improvements (avg batch size from 4 -> 8) reduce cost per token by ~18%.

Negotiation asks prepared for procurement:
- Commitment tiers with a 6-month ramp clause (start smaller, step up to full commit)
- SLA: p95 latency target with credits tied to p99 for critical routes
- Breakage: ability to re-tier GPU family (e.g., move to next-gen hardware) after 12 months with prorated pricing adjustment
- Audit: proof-of-performance (traces + sample traces) for 30-day window before final sign-off

Deliverables asked by Pelagia: 3-month POC (measurable KPIs: avg token cost, p95 latency, outage MTTR), monthly cost cadence, and a reserve buyback option if utilization remains <50% after quarter 2.
